versions.changelog:
- Added support and documentation for extracting data from documents using base64 content and file URLs, in addition to file upload.
- Updated description and examples to mention raw OCR text output ("ocr_text") in API responses.
- Clarified when to use the generic "any-documents" endpoint for W-2 and W-8 forms.
- Improved documentation structure, quick start, and included a direct link to Veryfi’s website for more information.

Veryfi Documents AI 1.0.0 initial release

- OpenClaw skill definition (`SKILL.md`) with full API reference for Veryfi Documents AI
- Support for receipts and invoices via `/api/v8/partner/documents/`
- Support for bank statements via `/api/v8/partner/bank-statements/`
- Support for checks via `/api/v8/partner/checks/`
- Support for W-9 forms via `/api/v8/partner/w9s/`
- Support for 30+ document types via Any Document endpoint (`/api/v8/partner/any-documents/`) with blueprints
- Document classification endpoint (`/api/v8/partner/classify/`) with 15 built-in types and custom type support
- Bounding box and confidence score options for layout analysis
- Fraud detection metadata in responses for receipts, invoices, checks, and bank statements
- Complete response schemas for all endpoints
- OpenClaw configuration examples (environment variables and inline config)
- Security and privacy guidelines for credential management and data handling
- Troubleshooting guide for common API errors
- `package.json` with OpenClaw metadata, required environment variables, and endpoint declarations
